cpmplus.w6animx.menu.situations: Movement that stops when the situation changes…
cpmplus.w6animx.menu.situations.desc: Shows parts that move while walking/standing but stop when jumping, falling or sneaking.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.title: Movement that stops when the situation changes
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.intro: In game only one situation plays at a time (standing, walking, jumping...). A part the current situation doesn't animate stops and goes back to its normal position.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.sentence: '%s' moves in %s, but not in %s: it stops and goes back to its normal position %s.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.note.custom: During a custom pose or gesture the situations don't play; use Global or an on/off button.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.note.server: Jumping and Falling depend on the server: other players may not see those situations.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.preview: The movement of '%s' goes to a Global animation, which always plays. It will also play in: %s, during gestures and custom poses.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.conflicts: These animations still move that part (with the same priority, a replacing Global wins over the situation):
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.notEqual: The tracks of this part are not the same in every situation; use 'Copy to the missing situations'.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.globalBusy: The Global animation already moves that part; merge by hand or use 'Copy to the missing situations'.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.done: The movement of '%s' is now in '%s'
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.from: Copy the movement of '%s' from '%s' to:
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.adjust: Fit the key times to each animation's length
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.jump: Animations with a different length may jump when switching.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.warn: %s part(s) stop moving in some situations. Example: %s
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.when.falling: when falling more than about 4 blocks
cpmplus.w6animx.part.head: Head
cpmplus.w6animx.err.noAnimation: Select an animation first (Animate tab, animation list).
cpmplus.w6animx.lock.additive: This animation adds to Minecraft, so locking changes nothing (adding zero). To lock, it must replace Minecraft's movement: that applies to every part of this animation. Another option is 'No Minecraft animation' on the part (always).
cpmplus.w6animx.lock.head: The head will stop following the mouse in this animation. Continue?
cpmplus.w6animx.lock.intro: Adds still keys (0) to '%s' in animation '%s', at the start and the end, only in the checked channels that have no keys yet.
cpmplus.w6animx.lock.nothing: Nothing to do: these channels already have keys.
cpmplus.w6animx.lock.title: Lock here (stop the swing)
cpmplus.w6animx.return.intro: %s position/rotation keys of '%s' in animation '%s' make Minecraft stop moving that part.
cpmplus.w6animx.return.mode.subgroup: Move them to a sub-group (nothing lost)
cpmplus.w6animx.return.none: '%s' has no position/rotation keys in this animation.
cpmplus.w6animx.return.title: Give back to Minecraft
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.done: %s created, %s animations adjusted; scale now works in game
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.dup: The name can't end in '_dup' (CPM uses that for part copies).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.noChildren: This body part has nothing inside: there is nothing to move into a sub-group.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.nothing: Nothing to move: the sub-group already has everything.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.notRoot: Right-click a Minecraft body part (head, body, arm, leg).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.onlyVanilla: This body part only holds Minecraft's original cube (or slots / copies): check 'Also move Minecraft's original cube' so the scale works on it.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.reserved: That name belongs to a Minecraft part; pick another.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.err.taken: Another group already has that name.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.intro: Creates a group inside '%s' with the same pivot and moves the chosen parts and keys into it. The game ignores scale on body parts; on the sub-group it works.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.moveVanilla.desc: It becomes a custom cube and scales too, but the skin's 2nd layer of this part is no longer drawn (unless you have the 2nd layer cube).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.multiAxis: Rotation on 2 or more axes in an additive animation: the result may differ slightly (composed rotation).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.name: Name
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.noAnims: No animation moves this part yet: only the parts are moved.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.nonAdditive: Also move rotation/position of non-additive animations
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.nonAdditive.desc: If moved, Minecraft's swing/head look adds back underneath this animation (good to keep the head look, wrong for poses that replace it, like sitting).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.retarget: Groups that copy this part's movement copy the sub-group instead
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.retarget.desc: Unchecked (default): they keep copying the body part, with Minecraft's movement.
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.reuse: '%s' already exists: it will be reused (no new group inside).
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.title: Create animation sub-group
cpmplus.w6animx.sub.vanillaStays: Minecraft's original cube stays in the body part: it does not turn or move with the sub-group.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.badge.rootScale: Scale on the body part: the game ignores it
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.intro: Animation '%s': what happens to each body part in game.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.noRoots: This model has no Minecraft body parts (head, body, arms, legs).
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.note.childOnly: Animating only the parts inside doesn't lock the limb; the lock is on the body part.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.note.head: This animation turns off the head look (the head doesn't follow the mouse).
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.note.preview: Blockbench's preview doesn't show Minecraft's swing or head look; check in game.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.summary.title: Summary of every animation
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.title: What moves each part?
cpmplus.w6animx.menu.xray.desc: For the selected animation: where it adds to Minecraft's movement and where it stops the swing or the look (the head stops following the mouse).
cpmplus.w6animx.menu.subgroup.desc: Creates '<part>_anim' inside the body part so scale works in game and the movement adds to Minecraft's.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.now.look: In '%s' the head stops following the mouse (rotation/position keys on the head in a non-additive animation). Click to open the X-ray: you can give the head back to Minecraft.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.now.child: '%s' keeps swinging with Minecraft in '%s': only the parts inside it are animated. Click to open the X-ray: you can lock it.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.warn.look: %s animation(s) make the head stop following the mouse: %s. If that was not intended, open the X-ray and use Give back to Minecraft.
cpmplus.w6animx.xray.note.posLocked: CPM rule: in a non-additive animation, rotating the arm/leg also fixes its POSITION at the standing one. If it plays while sneaking or swimming, the limb sits about 3 px off. To avoid it: 'Create sub-group' and move the rotation there, or make the animation additive.
